name: CMOS latched clock gate
description: A sixteen-MOS clock gate combines a low-transparent enable latch with a static clock AND. Enable changes while clk is high are deferred until a low phase, so the tested output pulses are neither introduced nor truncated mid-cycle. The saved 3.3 V transient checks disabled windows, complete enabled high pulses and intervening low phases with asynchronous enable transitions. Nominal educational models; no clock-tree, setup/hold boundary, jitter or PVT qualification.
